title: Code 430 lap timer v0
description: Start lines a map pack times laps across (add-proving-ground). Local metres, x east, z south. A lap starts when a car crosses the line in its direction and ends when it crosses again; the readout shows only while the player is on one of the named loop roads.

direction.description: Unit direction of travel across the line.

half_width_m.description: Half the line's length across the road.

rearm_s.description: Seconds after a crossing before the line counts again.

loop_names.description: Road names that make up the loop; off them the readout hides.
